title: 14 The Imaginary Friend · 看不见的朋友

sents.t: "My friend Audrey told me her daughter had a friend she played with, thinking just an imaginary friend.
sents.zh: “我的朋友 Audrey 跟我说，她女儿有个一起玩的朋友，她以为只是想象出来的朋友。

sents.t: Audrey couldn't believe how fast her daughter's room would get messy right after cleaning it.
sents.zh: Audrey 不敢相信，女儿的房间刚收拾好就那么快又变乱了。

sents.t: So as her daughter was in the room talking to herself, Audrey decided to take a photo.
sents.zh: 所以趁女儿在房间里自言自语时，Audrey 决定拍张照片。

sents.t: Later that night, Audrey was skimming through the photos, and this is what was in the photo."
sents.zh: 那天晚上，Audrey 翻看照片时，照片里出现了这个。”

sents.t: Audrey also adds that if you look closely, there appears to be a floating head by the closet doorway.
sents.zh: Audrey 还补充说，仔细看的话，衣柜门口好像有一颗飘浮的头。

sents.t: Now, I know some people are against this, but maybe using a Ouija board might help in finding out if your child is playing with a ghost.
sents.zh: 我知道有些人反对这么做，但也许用通灵板能帮你弄清楚孩子是不是在和鬼玩。

sents.t: But it's probably best to seek help elsewhere, as reaching out to the dead seems like a bad idea.
sents.zh: 不过最好还是找别的办法求助，因为和死者联系似乎不是个好主意。
